== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A Watchman is a member of the [[Blackwatch]], an order founded by a woman who chose the title to avoid appearing superior to her male peers. The organization is represented by a crest known as the Elder’s Eyes, which depicts six inhuman eyes over a nest of tentacles. The primary mission of the [[Blackwatch]] is to protect humanity by studying and utilizing the powers of [[Elders]] for the benefit of the empire. This involves researching Elder biology to better understand and oppose them, as members believe that studying these beings is essential for effective opposition. [[Watchmen]] are identifiable by their black uniforms and possess a level of Authority{{!}}authority that extends even over [[Elders]]. They operate in dangerous environments like the [[Aion Sea]], where they track and attempt to summon [[Elderspawn]]. Due to their specialized duties involving unpredictable and terrifying creatures, many people avoid them. Some members of the order report developing a heightened sense of awareness through years of close encounters with [[Elders]]. While their work is dangerous and often involves facing unknown threats, they are sworn to protect the citizenry from the terrors of the [[Elders]].}}
